projects.title: Zapier Webinar Funnel - SalesKick to Facebook Conversions API
summary: Operations automation • Automate inbound/outbound communications with fast routing
Eliminated repetitive manual steps across the workflow
Faster response time and fewer missed handoffs
Error handling and edge-case coverage to reduce operational risk.
projects.solution: Automated the webinar registration and purchase funnel for an AI education institute using Zapier and server-side tracking integrations.
projects.whatIBuilt: I built multi-step Zapier Zaps that capture new SalesKick form submissions and webinar registrations via Webhooks by Zapier, route leads through conditional Paths for segmentation, and send server-side conversion events to the Facebook (Meta) Conversions API. This includes passing hashed user data (email, phone, name) and event IDs to ensure accurate attribution, improved tracking reliability, and reduced cost-per-lead. The system keeps SalesKick, landing pages, and Meta Ads fully synchronized in real time.
projects.outcome: Improved conversion tracking accuracy, reduced cost-per-lead, and better Meta Ads optimization through reliable server-side attribution.
challenges: Ensuring accurate event deduplication between browser and server events
Maintaining consistent data mapping across SalesKick and Meta CAPI
Handling edge cases in webhook delivery and retries

projects.title: AI Sales Call Review Automation
projects.role: AI Automation Engineer / Make.com & Zapier Developer
summary: Automated sales call transcription review and scoring.
Reduced manual QA work for sales managers.
Improved feedback speed and coaching consistency.
projects.solution: Built an AI-powered sales call auditing system that automatically processes call transcripts and generates structured performance reviews.
projects.whatIBuilt: When a Zoom call ends, Fathom generates the transcript and Zapier captures it, then sends the payload (transcript, rep name, call date) to a Make.com webhook. Make parses the JSON and runs a multi-step OpenAI (GPT / o-series) prompt chain that evaluates the call against a custom audit rubric, scoring areas like discovery, objection handling, pitch quality, and pricing discussion. The final structured review is posted to a Slack channel (#sales-call-reviews) and tagged to the relevant sales rep, with retry logic and failure alerts routed to #automation-errors.
projects.outcome: Automated sales call evaluation and improved coaching feedback speed and consistency.
challenges: Ensuring consistent scoring across different call types
Handling incomplete or noisy transcript data
Maintaining reliable webhook delivery between Zapier and Make.com
Reducing false negatives in AI evaluation outputs
results: More consistent and structured performance evaluations
Improved visibility into sales team performance

about.profileText: Agustine Gonzalez - California, USA. Full Stack Developer & AI/Automation Engineer.
story: I am a Full Stack AI Developer specializing in AI-powered web applications, intelligent automation, and scalable SaaS platforms. I help startups and businesses transform ideas into production-ready software with modern technologies and AI-driven solutions.

My experience spans the complete product lifecycle—from designing intuitive user interfaces and developing high-performance backend APIs to architecting cloud-native applications, integrating third-party services, and building secure, scalable systems. I primarily work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and modern API-first architectures.

Beyond traditional software development, I build AI assistants, AI agents, RAG applications, and workflow automation using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, LangGraph, n8n, Make.com, and MCP. I also develop CMS-driven platforms with WordPress, Laravel, PHP, and Webflow while integrating payment gateways, authentication systems, and cloud services to deliver complete end-to-end products.
principles: Build complete products from concept to production with clean, scalable architecture.
Use AI, automation, and intelligent workflows to solve real business problems.
Prioritize performance, security, maintainability, accessibility, and exceptional user experience.
Deliver production-ready software with clear communication and long-term technical partnership.
